faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is PodEditor truly free and zero-server?
faq.a1: Yes! PodEditor runs 100% in your browser using the HTML5 Web Audio API and WebAssembly. No account is required, no usage limits exist, and not a single byte of your audio is ever sent to a remote server.
faq.q2: What audio file formats are supported?
faq.a2: You can import MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, FLAC, and OGG files. You can export studio-grade 16-bit uncompressed WAV or high-bitrate MP3.
faq.q3: How does the auto silence remover work?
faq.a3: PodEditor performs real-time RMS (Root Mean Square) energy scanning across your audio waveform. It marks audio below your chosen threshold that exceeds your max silence limit, leaving natural pauses intact.
faq.q4: Can I manually keep or restore a silence?
faq.a4: Yes! You can click directly on any highlighted silence region on the waveform to toggle between Cut (red strip) and Keep (mint speech).
